command: (format t "~&REPL-READING-PASS: held Topic EQ=~S; ~D Topics; ~D Associations; ~D Roles; Occurrences ~D -> ~D~%" (eq *held-question* (find-topic *example-map* "urn:topic-maps:question:Q-XTM-LOOP")) (length (topic-map-topics *example-map*)) (length (topic-map-associations *example-map*)) (loop for a in (topic-map-associations *example-map*) sum (length (association-roles a))) (loop for topic in (topic-map-topics *fresh-original*) sum (length (topic-occurrences topic))) (loop for topic in (topic-map-topics *example-map*) sum (length (topic-occurrences topic))))
